shortDescription: Poland's state-controlled energy group Orlen GPW:PKN said late on Wednesday it planned to launch a squeeze-out of remaining shares in its Energa GPW:ENG unit at 27.60 zlotys ($7.17) per share.It currently holds a 95.24% stake after the registration of Energa's share capital increase resulting from…

children: said late on Wednesday it planned to launch a squeeze-out of remaining shares in its Energa
It currently holds a 95.24% stake after the registration of Energa's share capital increase resulting from a share issue proposed by Orlen.
Orlen said the planned price reflects fair value determined by an auditing firm
The announcement of the squeeze-out will take place on September 30
Orlen acquired a majority stake in Energa in 2020
